marketing_description: The Milwaukee® M18 Fuel™ SURGE™ Series 1/4 in Hex Hydraulic Driver Kit features an 18 V brushless motor delivering 0 to 3000 RPM, 0 to 4000 IPM, and 450 in-lb of torque across three speed settings and 4-mode drive control. Powered by an M18™ 5 Ah REDLITHIUM™ battery with REDLINK PLUS™ intelligence, this 5 in black and red tool utilizes a trigger switch for operation. The kit provides 50% quieter operation and 3X longer sustained torque.
